definitions.explanation: Unable to wait calmly; tending to rush or hurry. Describes someone who wants things done quickly and gets frustrated by delays.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧せっかち⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}てず→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: He's impatient and takes the stairs because he can't wait for the elevator.

examples.japanese: せっかち⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}したい→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: I want to fix my impatient nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんなに→そんなに：01646_sonnani⟧せっかち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならないで→なる：01970_naru⟧。⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Don't be so impatient. We still have time.

notes:
USAGE:
- せっかち⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ / せっかち⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (an impatient person / personality)
- せっかち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to get impatient)
- せっかち⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{食|た}べ{方|かた}→食べ方：27437_tabekata⟧ (eating hastily)

NUANCE:
Mildly negative — it suggests someone who rushes unnecessarily or cannot relax. Often used self-deprecatingly about oneself, and it is not rude about a close friend, but avoid applying it to a superior.

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{急|せ}く→急く：noentry⟧ (an older verb meaning to hurry, related to ⟦{急|いそ}ぐ→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧) plus the suffix 〜かち (tendency toward). Literally "a tendency to rush."

CONTRAST:
- せっかち ↔ ⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧ (impatient ↔ easygoing, relaxed)
- せっかち ↔ ⟦{気長|きなが}→気長：20721_kinaga⟧ (impatient ↔ patient)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{慌|あわ}てる→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧ (to panic, to rush): a one-time reaction, not a standing trait
- ⟦そそっかしい→そそっかしい：06647_sosokkashii⟧ (careless): rushing that produces mistakes
